title: New optional/accumulating state surfaces: fixtures include absent/legacy shapes from day one
content: When adding a new optional or accumulating state surface (owner lane, provisioned store, registry, spool), its test fixtures must include the never-provisioned/absent, legacy-shaped, oversized, and orphaned forms of that state from day one — not only the fully-provisioned happy shape — and invariance assertions over such state must first prove the compared state is non-trivially present. Encoded from the 2026-08 catalog-cut fixture-gap post-mortem (24 production defects structurally unreachable from a certified pre-provisioned-happy suite; each fix landed with the pinning test closing its gap; record: thread-fcbdf795).
